note: The cry いてて is no 凍てる (いてる).
The cry うりゃ is no 売る (うる).
帰る in kana, which the tagger reads 孵る, is not carded 'to hatch'.
お|めで|と is no 愛でる.
The Kansai わい is no 沸く (わく).
A line-opening おいおい is the listed interjection, not the adverb 追い追い the tagger reads.
The いん of いるんだ is no 忌む.
A clause-final いい is 良い, not the stem of 言う the tagger reads.
Pieces of an unknown run of letters are no words, as for a katakana run.
か + なっ glued into かなっ is no 適う (かなう); the fixture dictionary has neither なんとか nor なる.
The kanji spelling is untouched by the kana lemma correction (おごる: 驕る → 奢る).
